You are not alone in these halls.

Wake up in an abandoned facility that changes every match. Restore the power, find the key, memorize the code and escape before it finds you.

A single creature lives here. It doesn't chase you all the time. It watches, waits and picks the right moment. Look back and it retreats. Stare too long and it loses its patience.

HOW IT WORKS
- Procedural map: every match is a different maze
- Find fuses and restart all 3 generators
- Bad fuses and sloppy repairs make the power fail sooner
- Hide, hold your breath and stay quiet
- When the last generator turns on, the lights go red and the hunt begins

TIPS
- Light is your best ally. Watch your flashlight battery.
- Being alone is dangerous. Being in a group guarantees nothing.
- The code is not saved anywhere. Remember it.

Play with friends in public or private rooms. You have 3 lives.

Cloversky Studios

10770728771.creator: Roblox Presents
10770728771.description:
There is no official record of ‘The Hollow.’
How long it has existed is unknown.
Its exact location is unclear.

We are asking you not to go in.

If you decide to go in anyway, please be advised: 

We cannot say where you will end up each night. 
You may think you know where you are.
You may recognize what is waiting for you. 
None of it should be there.

Some creators are going in live. 
We could not stop them.
They may need your help.

Other games may be connected to The Hollow. 
What you find there can help you inside.

If you are still there on October 31, you will not be the only one trying to get out. 
And not everyone will.

We cannot keep it closed. 
It opens October 22 2pm PT. It starts 3pm PT.

Anything you find is yours to keep.
Complete event quests, here and in participating experiences, to earn avatar items.
10770728771.name: The Hollow

1087859240.creator: Rogue Lineage
1087859240.description:
>> This game is incredibly difficult with little to no hand holding. Enter at your own risk. << 

Nominee for "Sleeper Hit" in the 7th Annual Bloxy Awards. 

Rogue Lineage is a fantasy game with roguelike elements. The game revolves around a permadeath mechanic, where each of your characters will have but a few lives before they die forever. You'll pass down some pieces of yourself to your heir, who'll become your next character. Players will progress by learning new abilities and trying to best their previous characters. Forge houses with your friends to take control of cities, or stick it out alone. Tackle injuries, diseases, and trauma as you struggle to survive in this testament to pain. 

Developed by: Ragoozer, Arch_Mage, Grimmkind, Melon_Sensei, aptorian, Rookie_Ethnic, Sherosama Contributions from: Nilvaat (Weapon Modelling), Blotnik (Clothing), x_o (Music), superstephon (Weapon Modelling) 

Huge Inspiration from Noloafing 
A game by Monad Studios.
1087859240.name: [🎃] Rogue Lineage

1093311378.creator: cyberpiper
1093311378.description:
Retrace the footsteps of our ancestors in an 1867 reconstruction of Victorian Luxembourg.

Race through the streets on a ‘Boneshaker’ velocipede, fly through the air on a steampunk flying machine or paddle down the river and view the city from the safety of your very own rowing boat.

There are more than 100 badges to be won from around this beautiful Victorian city.  Can you clear the rats from the courtyard and pick up pure from the streets, to earn some money for food?

Beware of rogues, ghosts, deadly traps and other dangers!

This game is based on an authentic reconstruction of 1867 Luxembourg. Historical documents and photographs have been used throughout, to create an authentic impression of what the city would have looked like during the mid-nineteenth century.

https://devforum.roblox.com/t/1476795
1093311378.name: 1867 Historical Role Play

1180269832.description:
**This game has thousands of items and textures so 6 GB+ RAM is recommended**
**Keyboard + Mouse Required to Play**
** Dragon Update Patch Notes: https://devforum.roblox.com/t/ao/4615115 **

Embark on an epic journey through the War Seas, taking part in the conflicts of kingdoms and organizations striving for power. Many will die, but only the strong survive in this harsh, magic-polluted world. 

Conflicts are high as the many kingdoms wage war over possession of Curses, powerful artifacts which grant the user immortality and great power. After defeating great rulers and psychopaths for what you believe is the greater good, you leave yourself questioning what your true purpose in this world is.

Fight against other players, or team up with them and rule the seas as a clan, capturing islands, building castles, and becoming more infamous. Since you were born a mage, you have the option of mastering your magic, or dropping it entirely in favor of fighting styles, weapon mastery, and more.

1184233856.creator: speedydude900
1184233856.description:
A cooperative sandbox zombie survival game with base building mechanics and weapon customization. This game is still in its Alpha stage so expect bugs and other issues. 

controls 
LMB - shoot (repair in build mode) 
RMB - aim (damage in build mode) 
E - melee 
G (5-6) - grenade 
R - reload (hold to rotate in build mode) 
Q - cycle sights 
V - cycle firing mode 
T - toggle/cycle all attachment modes 
F - interact 
`/~ - free mouse/manual attachment mode toggle (open buildable menu in build mode) 
B - enter build mode 
shift - sprint 

Paid access price will lower as development milestones are reached. Your cash will be reset & levels/weapons records will be reduced by 80% once the game fully releases.
1184233856.name: Stranded on Earth [Alpha]

Welcome to Edgeworks! a VR exclusive game about physics puzzles, freerunning, parkour and climbing!

If you have Criticism/critique, or issues with the game PLEASE get in touch.

Known headsets compatibility issues:
Oculus: None. this game was developed and designed around Oculus Headsets.

Vive, WMR, Valve Index: Jumping can be done by clicking the right thumbstick. (or middle of the trackpad)
mag dropping can only be done by tapping the current mag with a fresh one.

these issues are caused by the roblox engine, and are not likely to be fixed until roblox themselves fix it. (which is not likely)

Creative Attributes:

3047037061.creator: bLockerman666
3047037061.description:
Game made by bLockerman666 and aamo_s.

You can customize the board in private servers! (Note that wins don't count in them)
If you don't want to beat the tutorial, you can either skip it temporarily or play in a private server.
Exploiting of any sorts is NOT allowed in this game, and you will be punished for it.

How to play:
The board is divided into tiles, with mines randomly distributed.
To win, you need to step on all the safe tiles, without stepping on a mine.
The number on a tile shows the number of mines around it in a 3x3 area.
Using this information, you can determine tiles that are safe, and tiles that contain mines.
Tiles suspected of being mines can be marked with a flag using the left mouse button.

[How To Fish]
• Hold down to cast your bobber
• Await a bite. You can "shake" your rod to attract fish faster
• When you have a bite, hold down or click to pull the white bar. Follow the blue line to the best of your ability; it's okay to mess up a few times!
• When the progress bar on the bottom is full, you'll reel in your catch!
